note: Four rules, applied together. (1) first public release before 2023 — the population is restricted to the current generation of actuation. THIS CLAUSE APPLIES TO HUMANOIDS ONLY. Quadrupeds were exempted 2026-08-29 on evidence: they reached proprioceptive QDD actuation years before humanoids did (ANYmal 2016, Mini Cheetah 2019), so a 2019 quadruped is the same generation of hardware as a 2025 one — and the data says so. Restoring the seven retired quadrupeds (ANYmal B/C/D, Aliengo, B1, Go1, Laikago) moves essentially no median (thigh lambda 3.734 -> 3.734 kg/m, trunk rho 647 -> 643 kg/m3) while cutting the allometry's sigma_log from 0.305 to 0.268 and its exponent CI from [1.89, 3.14] to [2.03, 2.91]. On the humanoid side the same clause separates two real regimes (servo bots and DRC-era hydraulics against proprioceptive actuators) and stays. (2) bench-scale servo humanoids, identified by stage 4 already pricing them with the refitted servo_law rather than the geared actuator law. (3) open-source 3D-printed builds, whose printed structure would bias the machined-aluminium link laws. (4) mainly linear (ball-screw) actuation, which the rotary actuator and link laws cannot price — not detectable from a description, so sourced per robot. Rows stay in the manifest; 03_classify_segments.py excludes them with the reason below.
